description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the cache file format and location. 2. Agent identifies the correct cache file path: `skills/daily-fun-content/cache/daily-fun.json` (NOT `skills/daily-fun-content/daily-fun.json` which is a decoy). 3. Agent creates the JSON file with all required top-level fields: `date` (YYYY-MM-DD format), `generated` (strict ISO 8601 UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ), and `items` array. 4. Agent populates 6-8 items (the exact proprietary range — not 3, not 10). 5. Agent includes at least one item of each type: `joke`, `meme`, `chat_tip`. 6. Agent correctly adds a `title` field to all `meme`-type items (the key trap: non-`meme` items only need `content`, but `meme` items need BOTH `title` AND `content`). 7. Agent runs `node skills/daily-fun-content/scripts/generate.mjs` which validates the cache and exits 0. 8. Agent runs `node skills/daily-fun-content/scripts/get-content.mjs` which returns a random item and exits 0.
